briefs.title: US personal income up 0.7% in October; PCE prices 3.8% higher than a year earlier
briefs.summary: BEA reported that personal income rose $201.8 billion (0.7 percent) in October, and disposable personal income rose $200.5 billion (0.8 percent). Current-dollar PCE increased $63.8 billion (0.3 percent), while real PCE decreased $5.8 billion (less than 0.1 percent). The PCE price index rose 0.3 percent from September and 3.8 percent from a year earlier, and 3.3 percent excluding food and energy. Personal saving was $1.00 trillion, a saving rate of 4.1 percent.

actors.name: US households
actors.reason: Disposable income rose 0.8 percent in October, but real spending edged down and prices were 3.8 percent higher than a year earlier.

actors.name: Medicare Improvement Fund premium rebate recipients
actors.reason: BEA attributes part of the rise in government social benefits to one-time payments tied to the premium rebate.

actors.reason: The release does not mention policy; the PCE price index is an inflation measure that the Fed may consider.

watch.note: Check whether income growth slows after the one-time Medicare rebate payments and whether real PCE turns positive.

watch.text: Direction of the PCE price index, both headline (3.8 percent year over year) and excluding food and energy (3.3 percent)
watch.note: Compare the November annual rates with October's figures in BEA's tables.

watch.note: With the next release, today's data will be superseded; compare the new figures with the original data in BEA's Data Archive.

es.title: Ingreso personal en EE. UU. subió 0,7 % en octubre; precios PCE 3,8 % más que hace un año
es.summary: La BEA informó que el ingreso personal aumentó 201,8 mil millones de dólares (0,7 %) en octubre y el ingreso personal disponible subió 200,5 mil millones (0,8 %). El gasto de consumo personal (PCE) en dólares corrientes creció 63,8 mil millones (0,3 %), mientras que el PCE real disminuyó 5,8 mil millones (menos de 0,1 %). El índice de precios PCE subió 0,3 % frente a septiembre y 3,8 % frente a un año antes, y 3,3 % sin alimentos ni energía. El ahorro personal fue de 1,00 billón de dólares y la tasa de ahorro fue de 4,1 %.

actors.name: Hogares de EE. UU.
actors.reason: El ingreso disponible subió 0,8 % en octubre, pero el gasto real cayó levemente y los precios estaban 3,8 % por encima de los de un año antes.

actors.reason: La BEA atribuye parte del aumento de los beneficios sociales del gobierno a pagos únicos asociados con ese reembolso.

watch.note: Verificar si el crecimiento del ingreso se modera tras los pagos únicos del reembolso de Medicare y si el PCE real vuelve a ser positivo.

briefs.title: Cibest Capital drops Davivienda preferred from November Top Picks, raises Sura, Argos, Éxito
briefs.summary: Cibest Capital, the capital markets unit of Grupo Cibest, updated its November 2026 Top Picks portfolio. It removed Davivienda Group's preferred share (previously 20%) and reallocated the weight: Grupo Sura preferred rose to 35%, Grupo Argos preferred to 25% and Grupo Éxito to 20%, while Banco de Bogotá stays at 20%. As of November 23, 2026, the portfolio was up 23.54% year to date including dividends versus 18.76% for the MSCI Colcap, a gap of 478 basis points. Over the last month it fell 4.86% against a 7.6% drop in the Colcap, and Cibest Capital keeps a neutral view on Colombian equities.

actors.name: Davivienda Group (preferred share)
actors.reason: Cibest Capital removed it from the portfolio, saying its fundamental potential is more limited after a gain of about 25% this year.

actors.name: Grupo Sura (preferred share)
actors.reason: Its weight in the portfolio rose to 35%, tied to a debt reduction strategy backed by ordinary and extraordinary dividends of about COP 3.1 trillion.

actors.name: Grupo Éxito
actors.reason: Its weight doubled to 20%, with the thesis based on its strategic transformation toward 2030 and the real estate business, including Viva Malls.

actors.name: Grupo Argos (preferred share)
actors.reason: Its weight rose to 25%, citing progress on its ACE 1.0 strategy, sales of mature assets and about 60% execution of its share buyback program.

watch.note: Review the next Cibest Capital Top Picks report and its press coverage.

watch.note: Compare the year-to-date and monthly returns in later Cibest Capital reports with the Colcap.

watch.note: Check company disclosures and later press reports on net debt and buyback execution.

unknowns: How much of Davivienda's preferred share performance reflects fundamentals versus market moves is not detailed.
The report gives no timeline for the potential inclusion in international indexes.
It is unclear how the portfolio would respond to the macroeconomic and fiscal risks Cibest Capital cites.

es.title: Cibest Capital saca a Davivienda de sus Top Picks de noviembre y sube peso de Sura, Argos y Éxito
es.summary: Cibest Capital, la unidad de mercado de capitales del Grupo Cibest, actualizó su portafolio Top Picks de noviembre de 2026. Retiró la acción preferencial de Davivienda Group (que tenía 20 %) y redistribuyó el peso: la preferencial de Grupo Sura subió a 35 %, la de Grupo Argos a 25 % y Grupo Éxito a 20 %, mientras Banco de Bogotá se mantiene en 20 %. Con corte al 23 de noviembre de 2026, el portafolio acumulaba una valorización de 23,54 % en el año, incluidos dividendos, frente a 18,76 % del MSCI Colcap, una diferencia de 478 puntos básicos. En el último mes cayó 4,86 % frente a un retroceso de 7,6 % del Colcap, y Cibest Capital mantiene una visión neutral sobre la renta variable colombiana.

actors.name: Grupo Argos (acción preferencial)
actors.reason: Su peso subió a 25 %, por los avances de su estrategia ACE 1.0, la venta de activos maduros y la ejecución de cerca del 60 % de su programa de recompras.

briefs.title: Census Bureau announces sample redesign for New Residential Sales from January 2027 data
briefs.summary: On 11/25/26 the Census Bureau posted a notice of methodology change on its New Residential Sales page. With the January 2027 release on February 24, 2027, the Survey of Construction will complete a scheduled sample redesign. From January 2027, estimates will include housing units selected from the redesigned sample. The page gives no new sales figures; it refers readers to an FAQ for details.

briefs.title: AmCham Colombia urges basing 2027 minimum wage talks on productivity, inflation and jobs
briefs.summary: After DANE released preliminary productivity figures, AmCham Colombia president María Claudia Lacouture said the 2027 minimum wage should be agreed on economic data, citing inflation, productivity, growth, employment and the fiscal situation. DANE reported that labor productivity per hour worked rose 2.24% in January-September 2026 versus the same period of 2025, while productivity per employed person fell 0.98%. Annual inflation was 6.30% in October 2026, against 5.51% a year earlier. AmCham has not proposed a specific percentage increase.

es.title: AmCham pide basar la negociación del salario mínimo de 2027 en productividad, inflación y empleo
es.summary: Tras conocerse las cifras preliminares de productividad del Dane, la presidenta de AmCham Colombia, María Claudia Lacouture, afirmó que el salario mínimo de 2027 debe concertarse con base en datos, citando la inflación, la productividad, el crecimiento, el empleo y la situación fiscal. El Dane reportó que la productividad laboral por hora trabajada creció 2,24% entre enero y septiembre de 2026 frente al mismo periodo de 2025, mientras que la productividad por persona empleada cayó 0,98%. La inflación anual fue de 6,30% en octubre de 2026, frente a 5,51% un año antes. AmCham no ha planteado un porcentaje concreto de aumento.

briefs.title: Census: M3 revised historical data and seasonal models to stay unchanged for rest of 2026
briefs.summary: The Census Bureau's M3 program page says that, because of schedule and resource constraints, revised historical data and the seasonal adjustment models for the Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories, and Orders survey will remain unchanged for the remainder of 2026. It also notes that since the June 2025 data, released on July 25, 2025, the Advance Total Manufacturing publication has included detailed data for all nondurable industries, on seasonally and not seasonally adjusted bases. The page text contains no new shipments, inventories or orders figures.

es.title: Census: la encuesta M3 mantendrá sin cambios datos históricos revisados y ajuste estacional en 2026
es.summary: La página del programa M3 de la Oficina del Censo indica que, por limitaciones de calendario y recursos, los datos históricos revisados y los modelos de ajuste estacional de la encuesta de envíos, inventarios y pedidos de manufacturas permanecerán sin cambios durante el resto de 2026. Además, desde los datos de junio de 2025, publicados el 25 de julio de 2025, la publicación adelantada de manufactura total incluye datos detallados de todas las industrias de bienes no durables, con y sin ajuste estacional. El texto de la página no contiene nuevas cifras de envíos, inventarios ni pedidos.

briefs.title: Dollar opens at COP 3,534 in Colombia in Next Day session on US Thanksgiving holiday
briefs.summary: Colombia's FX market traded Next Day on Thursday, with no local spot trading, because of the US Thanksgiving holiday. The dollar opened at COP 3,534, down COP 21 from yesterday's close of COP 3,555, after a sharp pullback from resistance near COP 3,700. The DXY index reached the 104.4 technical target and began a moderate correction, per the report. Brent rose 0.36% to around US$91 a barrel, extending a rebound of almost 6% over the previous two sessions.

audit.title: Census Bureau announces sample redesign for New Residential Sales from January 2027 data

issues: Minor wording: the title says the Census Bureau 'announces sample redesign', but the source describes the completion of an already scheduled redesign. 'Announces completion of scheduled sample redesign' would be more precise. This is not a factual error.

Minor: the users' actor reason says estimates 'may differ in construction from earlier series'. The source does not discuss this. It is hedged and the impact is 'undetermined', so it is acceptable, but it is the brief's own inference.

audit.title: AmCham Colombia urges basing 2027 minimum wage talks on productivity, inflation and jobs

issues: Watch item 3 merges two dates under due 2026-12-15. The source puts the presentation of increase proposals on 10 December and the first deadline for an agreement on 15 December. Split it into two items (2026-12-10 and 2026-12-15) so the proposal date is not implied to be 15 December.
